output_list.criticism: The function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user's account to any value.

The function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing a user to cause an integer overflow on the recipients balance, if it occurs, it will be permanent.
